gappers.catalyst: Continued AI-infra rally tied to Nvidia's disclosed 9.3% stake in the neocloud provider
gappers.catalyst_detail: Nebius Group (Amsterdam-based 'neocloud' AI-infrastructure/GPU-cloud provider) is extending a sharp rally that began after Nvidia disclosed a 9.3% equity stake in the company (per CNBC). No same-day, NBIS-specific press release, 8-K, or earnings print was found as of this scan distinct from the ongoing Nvidia-stake storyline.
gappers.why: Nvidia's stake disclosure signals a strategic AI-infrastructure alliance, pulling in momentum buyers positioning Nebius as a key GPU-cloud capacity partner in Nvidia's ecosystem -- a structural narrative, not a single earnings-beat headline.
gappers.impact: Partly sustainable given the size/nature of the Nvidia relationship, but the ~9% premarket gap rode only ~418K shares of premarket volume -- thin, so watch for real-session volume confirmation at the open. Bullish read-across for other neocloud/GPU-cloud capacity names.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Only 1 gapper cleared the 5% bar today, so no other gapper is displaced. Still needs correlation-gate and sizing checks against current holdings before consideration -- not run here, research-only.
